title: A job-search belief barely moves
hook: Two stated cases: explore the weight given to repeated unfavorable news.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the weight given to repeated unfavorable news affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the weight given to repeated unfavorable news in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
